name: Google Arts & Culture
description_short: A free virtual museum of digitized art and cultural artifacts from institutions worldwide, browsable by artist, period, or theme — good source material for image description and cultural discussion.
teacher_note: Pull up a painting or artifact and have the student describe what they see before reading the caption — a change of pace from typical discussion prompts.
creator: Google
internal_notes: Verified live: free, no login required for core browsing. Personalization features (favorites, recommendations) need an optional Google account but don't gate basic use. age_group/cefr_level left unknown — general-purpose cultural resource, level demand depends entirely on how the teacher frames the discussion.
